name: button-variants
title: Button Variants
description: The cva variant map that `button.tsx` imports — variant × size class strings and nothing else. Pure CVA: no React, no client APIs, so a server component can style a plain `<a>` with `buttonVariants({ variant, size })`.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/button-variants

Installed to `components/ui/button-variants.ts`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/button-variants';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/button-variants

Requires the `@interlace/theme` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency).
